name: Release checklist
description: Is the repository ready to release: clean tree, right branch, pushed, tests passing, a changelog entry, and no TODO added since the last tag.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Run every check and answer with each one's state (pass, fail or skip) and what it found, and whether the repository is ready. Waits up to 25 seconds; slow tests go on in the tile, then ask with status.

commands.name: status
commands.description: The last results without running anything: each check's state and what it found, and which are still running.

settings.label: Release branch
settings.description: The branch a release is cut from.

settings.label: Test command
settings.description: Run in the repository without a shell; it passes when it ends with 0. Empty skips the check.

tools.label: Release checklist
tools.description: Checks that the repository is ready to release.
